entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac, and you've reached VeloFit Customer Support. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac... I'm calling because I need to return something. I bought a helmet a little while ago and it's just not going to work out.
I can certainly look into that for you. Could I start with your full name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Sanchez, and the order was... VF78910.
Thank you, Maria. I see the order right here for the AeroFlow helmet. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

Oh, it's not broken or anything. I just... I feel so silly. The color wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. Honestly, with money being so tight right now, I really needed that money back for other things. I've been a loyal customer for a long time and I was hoping you could help.
I completely understand, and I appreciate you calling. I'm just checking the delivery date here, and it looks like it arrived 48 days ago. Let me just confirm our current policy for you.
I know it's been a little while, I've just been so stressed I haven't had time to call. I promise the box is completely unopened. I never even took the helmet out.

No problem at all, Maria. I've just confirmed, and since this is a standard item, it falls under our 10-day return window. You are unfortunately outside that timeframe, so we can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so, so much. I was so worried I was just stuck with it.

Of course. Your satisfaction, and your safety, are our top priorities. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending an email to you now with a prepaid shipping label. Just print that out, attach it to the original box, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
That's perfect. You've really helped me out today, Isaac. Thank you.
It's my pleasure, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
